title: SvgFeOffset
responsibility: Renders the native feOffset element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeOffset.attributes
inputs.description: Native feOffset attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeOffset.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feOffset element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeOffset
outputs.description: The actual native feOffset element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
